_note: Edit on the server, no rebuild needed. Each festival shows automatically from start to end (YYYY-MM-DD, India time) and hides itself after. The greeting always shows. The offer line shows only if offer.enabled is true. An offer must be a BONUS (a free extra, faster delivery, a free add-on), never a lower price than the rate card. Do not write discount, percent off, or rupee amounts in offer text. Eid dates depend on the moon: confirm before the date.
